descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S04 「现成 spec：两个列表都能打开 Handoff；在浏览器里把交接发给一个同事；Copy 记下一条只到剪贴板的导出」 Existing specs: Handoff opens from both lists; a handoff is sent to a colleague in the browser; Copy records a clipboard-only export

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context).（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 3；UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's navigation fixtures for each list; Tim's demo account with two probe patients and OTHER_USER as colleague

When Tap Handoff on the Hospital list and on the Nursing Home hub; open /rounding/handoff, wait for Send, pick the colleague by name, send; open Handoffs → Sent → detail. Separately press Copy Text

Then The 'Handoff Summary' heading shows in both contexts; no mailto: link or 'Email Handoff' button on any screen; 'Sent to <colleague>'; Sent record addressed by name with both patients in the text; Copy confirms and leaves an export row with destination 'clipboard'

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Navigation is reachability only. The send and copy tests are Hospital only, have no edit step, run on the no-AI template path, and the copy test reads neither the clipboard nor what the export row holds, so they are no evidence for U4, U9 'including edits', the export row carrying no text (S27) or Nursing Home (S03a, S03b). …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
